format: Studio / Custom events: placement-only publication and visibility defaults
requirement: DanceFlow policy: Studio/Custom results show placements (and rating bands where the method has them) only; visibility defaults to 'entrants' and becomes 'public' only by explicit organizer choice at publication; public results hide judge names and letters (owner decision O3, 2026-10-24); published results always reach entrants' portals (P10); unpublished results are readable by result managers (P5; the reader matrix also lists the scorer role, to be verified); public readers also require a published, public event. Preserved by OD-23 Option B for initial activation.
enforcement_point: F3 publish_competition_round_result (visibility default), competition_my_results, competition_round_results_public, viewer.ts, publication.ts, RESULT_READER_MATRIX (contract.ts).
interpretation_notes: Approved behavior documented in the K0 contract (O3, P5, P10) and implemented in F3; policy label and the report disclosure (OD-23 record section 2) do not exist on any surface yet. Not any body's rule.
decision_refs: OD-23 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B for initial Studio/Custom; Option A required for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
